hook.en: In 1824, diplomats in London drew a line through the Straits of Melaka. Families and kingdoms on either side were split — a line that still shapes the Malaysia–Indonesia border.
hook.bm: Pada 1824, diplomat di London menarik satu garisan merentasi Selat Melaka. Keluarga dan kerajaan di kedua-dua belah terpisah — garisan yang masih membentuk sempadan Malaysia–Indonesia.

bigIdeas.en: Britain gained Penang (1786), Singapore (1819) and Melaka (1824) through agreements.
bigIdeas.bm: British memperoleh Pulau Pinang (1786), Singapura (1819) dan Melaka (1824) melalui perjanjian.

bigIdeas.en: The London Treaty (Anglo-Dutch Treaty) of 17 March 1824 divided the Malay world between Britain and the Netherlands.
bigIdeas.bm: Perjanjian London (Perjanjian Inggeris-Belanda) 17 Mac 1824 membahagikan Alam Melayu antara British dan Belanda.

bigIdeas.en: The Straits Settlements were formed in 1826 and became a Crown Colony ruled from London in 1867.
bigIdeas.bm: Negeri-negeri Selat dibentuk pada 1826 dan menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota yang ditadbir dari London pada 1867.

detail.bm: Negeri-negeri Selat dibentuk; pusat di Pulau Pinang.
Tanah Jajahan Mahkota, ditadbir dari London.

definition.en: Anglo-Dutch treaty dividing the Malay world into British and Dutch spheres.
definition.bm: Perjanjian Inggeris-Belanda yang membahagikan Alam Melayu kepada lingkungan British dan Belanda.

definition.en: Penang, Melaka and Singapore under one British administration.
definition.bm: Pulau Pinang, Melaka dan Singapura di bawah satu pentadbiran British.

definition.en: Head of the Straits Settlements administration.
Officer in charge of each settlement.
Colony ruled directly by the British government in London.
definition.bm: Tanah jajahan yang ditadbir terus oleh kerajaan British di London.

question.en: Why did Straits traders want the Straits Settlements to be ruled from London instead of India?
question.bm: Mengapakah pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat mahu Negeri-negeri Selat ditadbir dari London dan bukan dari India?

steps.en: Rule from India was slow and did not understand local needs.
steps.bm: Pentadbiran dari India lambat dan tidak memahami keperluan tempatan.

steps.en: India tried to impose taxes and laws unsuitable for the settlements.
steps.bm: India cuba mengenakan cukai dan undang-undang yang tidak sesuai.

answer.en: They wanted faster decisions and better protection of trade — achieved in 1867.
answer.bm: Mereka mahukan keputusan lebih cepat dan perlindungan perdagangan yang lebih baik — tercapai pada 1867.

explanation.en: One Governor could manage all three.
explanation.bm: Seorang Gabenor boleh mentadbir ketiga-tiganya.

options.en: For easier, cheaper and more efficient administration
options.bm: Untuk pentadbiran yang lebih mudah, murah dan cekap

options.en: To return them to the Dutch

prompt.en: What type of rule did the Straits Settlements have?

explanation.bm: Tidak seperti negeri Melayu, tiada Sultan yang memerintah.

prompt.en: Why is the London Treaty 1824 still important today?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Perjanjian London 1824 masih penting hari ini?

explanation.en: Colonial agreements shaped modern borders.
explanation.bm: Perjanjian penjajah membentuk sempadan moden.

options.en: It laid the basis for the boundary between Malaysia and Indonesia
options.bm: Ia menjadi asas sempadan antara Malaysia dengan Indonesia

prompt.en: What does the London Treaty show about how the Malay world was treated?
prompt.bm: Apakah yang ditunjukkan oleh Perjanjian London tentang layanan terhadap Alam Melayu?

explanation.en: It was signed in London.
explanation.bm: Ia ditandatangani di London.

options.en: Western powers decided its future without consulting local rulers
options.bm: Kuasa Barat menentukan masa depannya tanpa berunding dengan pemerintah tempatan

options.en: It was a fair agreement for Malays
options.bm: Ia perjanjian yang adil untuk orang Melayu

prompt.en: How did becoming a Crown Colony in 1867 benefit Straits traders?

explanation.en: Traders had complained about rule from India.
explanation.bm: Pedagang telah merungut tentang pentadbiran dari India.

options.en: Decisions came directly from London and policies better protected trade
options.bm: Keputusan datang terus dari London dan dasar lebih melindungi perdagangan

prompt.en: How did the Straits Settlements later influence British intervention in the Malay states?

explanation.en: This led to the Pangkor Treaty in 1874.

options.en: Straits traders invested in tin and pressed Britain to restore order in the states
options.bm: Pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat melabur dalam bijih timah dan mendesak British memulihkan keamanan di negeri-negeri itu
